_meta.description: Per-state firearm-law grade, law count, and 6 headline policy flags for every year 1991–2025, for the historical year slider.
_meta.source: State Firearm Laws Database (Siegel et al., Boston University) for 1991–2020; 2021–2025 = 2020 baseline + curated overlay (tools/updates-2021-2025.js).
_meta.note: DC is held at its current snapshot (not in the historical DB). 2021–2025 reflects curated headline changes, not every amendment. Not legal advice.
